knowHow.text: Suggested uses are: functional prototypes, machining fixtures, injection molds, jigs, and low-volume production parts.
Bambu PAHT-CF is a high-temperature engineering-grade carbon-fiber reinforced nylon that is designed for applications where high strength, stiffness, and temperature resistance are required.
It is easy to print, has enhanced Z-bonding, a high-degree of dimensional stability, and has been optimized to retain excellent mechanical properties when wet.

strong | chemical resistant | ESD safe

Fix larger parts to avoid potential deformation during the annealing process.
Easy to print.

High z-strength.
nozzle material: abbrasion resistant
Low influence from moisture and temperature on dimensional stability and electrical properties, compared with PA66
nozzle material: abbrasion resistant
ideal for high-performance engineering and replacing automotive parts.
Quasi-metallic strength: Surpasses ordinary PA6-CF
Ultra-high temperature resistance: Withstands 227°C without losing structural integrity, suitable for extreme environments.
excellent anti-warping for large-size printing.
Industrial-grade accuracy: Ensures prototypes match drawings
Humidity stability: Performs well in humid conditions, maintaining stiffness and thermal properties.
Wide compatibility: Compatible with printers like P1S, X1C, and X1E, requiring a sealed box and hardened steel nozzle at 280°C to 310°C.

When printing a model with support, we recommend removing the support structures within 2 hours after printing to prevent them from sticking after absorbing moisture. If sticking occurs, dry the model to ease the removal.
